sentences.text: The Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion examined security for the Chanukah event at Bondi and counter-terrorism arrangements in its interim report.
sentences.support:
The context in which to consider the adequacy of the security arrangements for the 
Chanukah event

sentences.text: The Commission said further hearings were needed before it could assess whether security for the event was adequate.
sentences.support:
An assessment of the adequacy of these arrangements awaits further 
exploration in hearings.

sentences.text: The Commission proposed improvements to information sharing but did not suggest those changes would have prevented the attack.
sentences.support:
is not suggested that had any recommended change been in place on 14 December 2025 
the Bondi attack might have been averted.

sentences.text: Its 14 recommendations cover event security, counter-terrorism coordination, information sharing and firearms reform, with some recommendations kept confidential.
sentences.support:
The review should include consideration of leadership 
structures, team integration, systems access and information sharing arrangements.

findings.quote:
The procedures adopted by NSW Police in respect of Operation Jewish High Holy Days 
should apply to other high risk Jewish festivals and events, particularly those that have a 
public facing element.

The Commonwealth and states and territories should prioritise efforts to finalise and 
implement an updated and nationally consistent National Firearms Agreement.

notes: This is an interim report. Several chapters, parts of chapters and five recommendations are confidential; the summary does not infer their contents or treat matters awaiting hearings as findings.
